summary: Full backend + frontend testing for FORTIA SYSTEMS site. Backend contact API validated (create, list-sorted, empty company allowed, and 4 validation edge cases -> 422). Frontend: home hero, all 4 nav routes, all 8 brand cards on /marcas, empty-form validation toast, full contact submission flow with shadcn Select (reason=Cotizar proyecto) reaching success state and persisted via GET /api/contact.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is referenced inside create_contact (line 92) but is instantiated later at module scope (line 120). Works because it resolves at request time, but stylistically fragile - move logging.basicConfig/getLogger before route definitions.
server.py: CORS uses '*' when CORS_ORIGINS not set combined with allow_credentials=True is a browser-invalid combination; consider setting explicit origins for production.
Only status_checks endpoint is now unused (legacy scaffolding); could be pruned.
seed_data_creation: Test contacts created with TEST_/Playwright prefixes in db.contacts
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_contact_api.py and cover root, create success, empty company allowed, invalid email 422, missing email/name/reason 422, short message 422, and list-sorted-includes-created. Frontend submission uses shadcn Select which requires ~400ms wait between opening and clicking option (already handled). REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is https://fortia-portal.preview.emergentagent.com.
